F1.claim: Um painel de 21% de eficiência converte 21% da luz solar em eletricidade.
F1.quote: A 21% efficient panel converts 21% of available sunlight into power — the remaining energy is lost as heat and reflection.

F2.claim: Painéis residenciais padrão hoje têm eficiência entre 18% e 22%.
F2.quote: Standard residential panels today typically range from 18-22% efficiency

F3.claim: Panéis finos têm eficiência entre 15% e 22%.
F3.quote: Thin-film solar panels are the least efficient type of solar panel, with an efficiency rate ranging from 15-22%.
F3.source_title: What is the Efficiency Of Residential Solar Systems?

F4.claim: Panéis policristalinos são menos eficientes que os monocristalinos.
F4.quote: Polycrystalline solar panels, on the other hand, are less expensive but less efficient than monocrystalline panels.
F4.source_title: What is the Efficiency Of Residential Solar Systems?

F5.claim: O custo de instalação de painéis solares em casa era de $3.16/W há dez anos.
F5.quote: Ten years ago, a home solar installation cost $3.16/W according to the National Laboratory of the Rockies (formerly National Renewable Energy Laboratory).
F5.source_title: Solar Panel Cost In 2026: It May Be Lower Than You Think

F6.claim: O custo atual de painéis solares é 22% menor que o de há dez anos.
F6.quote: That's 22% more than what we see on EnergySage right now.
F6.source_title: Solar Panel Cost In 2026: It May Be Lower Than You Think

F7.claim: O custo dos painéis solares está em níveis históricos baixos em 2026.
F7.quote: as of 2026, solar prices are about the lowest they've been
F7.source_title: Solar Panel Cost In 2026: It May Be Lower Than You Think

F8.claim: A produção doméstica de painéis solares aumentou em quase 400% entre 2022 e 2024.
F8.quote: Domestic production of solar panels increased by nearly 400% between 2022 and 2024
F8.source_title: Solar Panel Costs Hit Record Lows in 2024 | EnergySage

F9.claim: O crédito fiscal residencial para energia solar está em risco de ser reduzido no final de 2025.
F9.quote: the 30% residential solar tax credit is at risk of being cut at the end of 2
F9.source_title: Solar Panel Costs Hit Record Lows in 2024 | EnergySage

F10.claim: Tigo foi fundado em Silicon Valley em 2007 para acelerar a adoção de energia solar.
F10.quote: Tigo was founded in Silicon Valley in 2007 to accelerate the adoption of solar energy
F10.source_title: ​​A Solar Powered Future: Residential Adoption on a Global Scale

F11.claim: A equipe global de Tigo apoia clientes cujos sistemas produzem gigawatt hours de energia solar segura em sete continentes.
F11.quote: its global team supports customers whose systems reliably produce gigawatt hours of safe solar energy on seven continents
F11.source_title: ​​A Solar Powered Future: Residential Adoption on a Global Scale

F12.claim: A instalação de painéis solares no Reino Unido leva de 4 a 8 semanas.
F12.quote: The typical timeframe for a solar panel installation in the UK—from initial enquiry to a fully operational system—is 4 to 8 weeks.
F12.source_title: How Are Solar Panels Installed? A Step-by-Step Guide

F13.claim: A tecnologia TOPCon e HJT é a mais eficiente disponível para residências, com eficiência em torno de 21-23%.
F13.quote: Premium TOPCon and HJT cell technology currently leads residential efficiency, around 21-23%.

F14.claim: Panéis de filme fino têm eficiência entre 15% e 22%.
F14.quote: Thin-film solar panels are lightweight and easy to move but are the least efficient type of solar panel, with an efficiency rate also ranging between 15-22%.
F14.source_title: What is the Efficiency Of Residential Solar Systems?
